meta.title: AI Agents, Chatbots & 24/7 Automation | Valadares Global Tech
meta.description: Chatbots, virtual assistants, and AI agents that work for you 24/7: WhatsApp support, calls, CRM, and process automation that connects your systems.

hero.title: Agents and chatbots that work for you, 24/7
hero.subtitle: We implement chatbots, virtual assistants, and intelligent agents that serve your customers, handle tasks, and connect your systems, around the clock and without hiring more staff.

includes.title: Agents and chatbots tailored to your operation
includes.subtitle: We design the agent or chatbot around what your business needs to solve.

items.title: Chatbots and virtual assistants
items.description: Assistants that answer FAQs, guide visitors, and serve your customers on your website and channels.

items.title: 24/7 WhatsApp agent
items.description: Serves customers, answers questions, books appointments, and follows up on WhatsApp, all day long.

items.title: Voice call agent
items.description: Answers and makes calls with a natural voice: customer service, reminders, and lead qualification.

items.title: CRM and sales agent
items.description: Captures leads, updates your CRM, follows up, and keeps your database always current.

items.title: Process automation
items.description: Connects your apps and systems so repetitive work happens on its own (e.g. your store with your accounting).

items.title: Custom autonomous agents
items.description: Agents with memory that execute real tasks for you and operate autonomously across your channels.

process.title: From your process to a working agent
process.subtitle: We design, integrate, and continuously improve the agent.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.description: We identify which tasks or channels are worth automating first.

steps.title: Agent design
steps.description: We define its skills, its tone, and the flows it will follow.

steps.title: Integration and training
steps.description: We connect it to your channels, data, and systems, and train it.

steps.title: 24/7 operation and improvement
steps.description: The agent works nonstop while we measure and optimize it.

deliverables.title: What you get
deliverables.subtitle: An agent or chatbot ready to work, integrated with your business.
items: Chatbot or agent deployed and running on your channels
Integrations with your systems and data

cta.title: Ready to have an agent working for you?
cta.subtitle: Tell us what you want to automate and we'll design the ideal chatbot or agent for your business.
